zel_operationalization.activation: One initial-thrust check for each original actual entry campaign; later reuse campaigns receive the same rule independently.
zel_operationalization.execution: Native floor, data safety and existing source-exit priority remain. No next actual open before terminal boundary means terminal mark with pending exit, not synthetic liquidation.
explicit_adaptations: An approximate source four-bar thrust becomes a one-time deterministic checkpoint.
The frozen reg71 signal replaces Carter's full TTM entry setup.
Net-of-cost profitability, completed4h clock and next-open fill semantics are ZEL choices fixed before outcomes.
zel_operationalization.mapping: The existing reg71 squeeze/continuation signal is the frozen release event. Do not add a new TTM squeeze or momentum filter.
zel_operationalization.observation_clock: Fourth completed native4h bar since actual entry, counting entry bar as completed bar1: j=entry_index+3.
zel_operationalization.profit_measure: unit_net_progress_bps = 10000*(completed_close/actual_entry_price-1) - frozen cost_at(cost, entry_ts, completed_close_ts). This defines unprofitable after costs rather than gross-price-only.
zel_operationalization.trigger: At that single fourth-bar close, if unit_net_progress_bps <=0 schedule this lot's remaining quantity to exit at the next actual observable open. If positive, disable this component for the rest of that campaign; no later rearm.
unchanged: D3 profit-only 1/3 partial if the lot survives
